_comment: Shared golden vectors for the two progress bars of the Today screen: how full
each bar is (clamped to 0..1) and how it reads (CALM, WARNING, DANGER). Loaded
by BOTH suites: LimitGaugeVectorTest.kt drives domain/LimitGauge.kt,
LimitGaugeVectorTest.swift drives PotillusKit's LimitGauge. Until the v0.86.0
review the Kotlin rules sat inline in two composables, unmeasured and untested.
The gram bar turns DANGER only when the limit is EXCEEDED (isOverLimit, with its
epsilon); reaching it exactly stays WARNING. The drink-day bar turns DANGER
when drinking NOW would spend a day the user does not have
(drinkDayLimitReached): at the cap with today already a drink day it is
WARNING, at the cap with today still dry it is DANGER.

grams.description: exactly at the limit is allowed: full and amber
a total that displays as the limit does not flip red
over the limit: fill clamped, red
an unconfigured limit draws an empty, calm bar

drinkDays.description: three of four with today still dry: the next drink spends the last day, amber
at the cap with today already a drink day: today is free, amber
at the cap with today still dry: the first drink spends a day the user does not have, red
over the cap: red either way, fill clamped
a cap of zero allows no drink day, so an empty bar is already red
